error: RangeError("Invalid JSON representation for SelectionRange")
condition: !json || typeof json.anchor != "number" || typeof json.head != "number" (selection.ts:103). NaN and fractional or negative numbers pass (typeof "number"; deduction from the code).
protects: Rejects a JSON value that cannot be turned into a range before EditorSelection.range(json.anchor, json.head) reads it (deduction: no comment).
checkable: yes: the condition is a plain shape test on the caller's own value (truthy object with numeric anchor and head); no cm6 API is needed.

error: RangeError("Invalid JSON representation for EditorSelection")
condition: !json || !Array.isArray(json.ranges) || typeof json.main != "number" || json.main >= json.ranges.length (selection.ts:176). A negative or fractional main passes (deduction from the code).
protects: Rejects a JSON value with no range array or a main index past the array, before the EditorSelection constructor stores them (deduction: no comment).
checkable: yes: shape test on the caller's own value (Array.isArray(json.ranges), typeof json.main, json.main < json.ranges.length).
public_entry: EditorState.fromJSON (state.ts:235, selection is required: an absent json.selection throws here)

error: RangeError("A selection needs at least one range")
condition: ranges.length == 0
protects: A selection always has at least one range (main is ranges[mainIndex]); deduction from the message and the class, no comment.
checkable: yes: ranges.length > 0 on the caller's array, or `selection.ranges.length > 0` before EditorSelection.map and replaceRange. Other paths reach it with a selection of zero ranges, which EditorSelection.fromJSON accepts with a negative or NaN `main` (selection.ts:176, Q12): EditorSelection.map through a change whose `empty` is false (selection.ts:129; change:F5500-F5504), so also a transaction with changes on a state holding that selection (Transaction.newSelection, transaction.ts:212; state:F1416, F1420), and replaceRange with its default `which` (mainIndex -1), which sets an array property and leaves the copy empty (selection.ts:164-165; change:F5506). addRange always passes at least one range (selection.ts:157).
public_entry: EditorState.update / Transaction.newSelection (state built by EditorState.fromJSON with zero ranges and allowMultipleSelections)

error: RangeError("Selection points outside of document")
condition: some range of the selection has range.to > docLength, where docLength is doc.length in EditorState.create (state.ts:250) or changes.newLength in the Transaction constructor (transaction.ts:185). Only the upper bound is checked: negative, fractional and NaN positions pass (state.EditorStateConfig.selection.B6; probe: {anchor: -1} accepted). Runs on every range before asSingle (state.ts:250-251).
protects: A selection stored in a state or transaction must lie inside its document (deduction from the message; no comment).
checkable: yes: compare every range's to (SelectionRange.to, EditorSelection.ranges) with doc.length, or with ChangeSet.newLength / the length of the document the spec is resolved against for a transaction (sequential specs resolve against the intermediate length, transaction.ts:349).
public_entry: EditorState.update (Transaction constructor, transaction.ts:185, also for a spec returned by a transaction filter)

error: RangeError(`Position ${pos} is out of range for changeset of length ${posA}`)
condition: after the section loop found no section containing pos: pos > posA, posA being the description's length (this.length). No lower bound: negative and fractional positions are mapped arithmetically, NaN returns without throwing (state.ChangeDesc.mapPos.B9; probe: mapPos(NaN) and mapPos(-1) on ChangeSet.empty(3) return without throwing).
protects: A position mapped through a change must lie in the change's start document (deduction from the message; no comment).
checkable: yes: pos <= desc.length (ChangeDesc.length). Through RangeSet.map, StateEffect.mapEffects and the transaction-extender merge the positions are not the caller's argument: the caller must check the set's / effect's positions against the change's length itself (deduction).
public_entry: EditorState.update (selection mapping in mergeTransaction, transaction.ts:323; transaction extenders, transaction.ts:313-314)

error: RangeError("Invalid JSON representation of ChangeDesc")
condition: !Array.isArray(json) || json.length % 2 || json.some(a => typeof a != "number") (change.ts:172). Negative, fractional or NaN numbers, and lengths not paired with valid ins values, pass (deduction from the code).
protects: Rejects input that is not a flat even-length number array, the sections layout (deduction).
checkable: yes: shape test on the caller's own value.

error: RangeError("Applying change set to a document with the wrong length")
condition: this.length != doc.length
protects: Class doc (change.ts:193-195): "It stores the document length, and can only be applied to documents with exactly that length."
checkable: yes: changes.length == doc.length (ChangeDesc.length, Text.length). EditorState.update does not check a top-level ChangeSet spec's length (transaction.ts:334), so it surfaces only at tr.newDoc / tr.state.

error: RangeError(`Mismatched change set length (got ${spec.length}, expected ${length})`)
condition: a ChangeSet found in the spec (spec instanceof ChangeSet, at any nesting depth) with spec.length != length. Not reached for a top-level ChangeSet passed to EditorState.update (transaction.ts:334 uses it directly).
protects: A nested ChangeSet is composed with changes for the same start document; its length must match (deduction from the message).
checkable: yes: nested.length == length (ChangeDesc.length).
public_entry: EditorState.update (a ChangeSet nested inside an array spec)

error: RangeError(`Invalid change range ${from} to ${to} (in doc of length ${length})`)
condition: for a non-array, non-ChangeSet spec, with to defaulting to from: from > to || from < 0 || to > length (change.ts:333), checked before the no-op skip. NaN or undefined from passes (all comparisons false; state.ChangeSpec.B5).
protects: A change must address a range of the document it is built for (deduction from the message).
checkable: yes: 0 <= from <= to <= length on the caller's spec, length being doc.length or, for a sequential transaction spec, the intermediate document length (transaction.ts:349); the length for transaction extenders is the new document length (transaction.ts:397).
public_entry: EditorState.update (each spec's changes; transaction extender results, transaction.ts:397)

error: RangeError("Invalid JSON representation of ChangeSet")
condition: !Array.isArray(json)
protects: Rejects a non-array JSON value (deduction).
checkable: yes: Array.isArray on the caller's value.

error: RangeError("Invalid JSON representation of ChangeSet")
condition: a part that is not a number and is not an array whose element 0 is a number and whose other elements are strings: !Array.isArray(part) || typeof part[0] != "number" || part.some((e, i) => i && typeof e != "string") (change.ts:365).
protects: Rejects parts outside the toJSON layout: number = kept length, [len] = deletion, [len, ...lines] = replacement (deduction from toJSON, change.ts:296-307).
checkable: yes: shape test on the caller's own value.

error: Error("Mismatched change set lengths")
condition: during the parallel walk, one iterator is done while the other still has length: a.done && b.len || b.done && a.len (change.ts:438). Reached only when the two descriptions have different lengths (deduction from the walk). Fixtures F0089, F0090, F0346, F0369 throw at this line (probe stack).
protects: Comment (change.ts:429-430): mapSet "Produce[s] a copy of setA that applies to the document after setB has been applied (assuming both start at the same document)". The throw rejects descriptions of different start documents.
checkable: yes: this.length == other.length (ChangeDesc.length). With unequal lengths the walk either throws here or at :487, or never terminates (state.ChangeDesc.mapDesc.B9); a probe of 3000 random unequal-length pairs with both non-empty found no silent success.

error: Error("Mismatched change set lengths")
condition: final else of the walk: none of the earlier branches applies and not (a.done && b.done) (change.ts:484-487). Reached by probe: [0,0,0,-1,2,1] (length 2) mapped over [0,2] (length 0) throws here; every recorded fixture throws at :439 instead.
protects: Same as change.ts:439 (descriptions must start from the same document; comment change.ts:429-430).
checkable: yes: this.length == other.length (same as change.ts:439).

error: Error("Mismatched change set lengths")
condition: after deletions in A and insertions in B are consumed: a.done || b.done while the other is not done (change.ts:508). Not reached when either side is empty: composeDesc/compose return the other side without a length check (change.ts:97, :238).
protects: composeDesc doc (change.ts:94-96): "The length of the document after this set should match the length before `other`."
checkable: yes: this.newLength == other.length (ChangeDesc.newLength, ChangeDesc.length). With one side empty a mismatch is accepted silently (probe: [3,-1] composed with [0,0] gives [0,0]).

error: Error("Config merge conflict for field " + (key as string))
condition: for a key of a later config: result[key] !== undefined && result[key] !== value && value !== undefined && !Object.hasOwnProperty.call(combine, key) (config.ts:15-19). result is a plain {} so keys named after Object.prototype members (toString, constructor, ...) already have a value (state.combineConfig.B8). Values equal in content but not === conflict (NaN, distinct objects, 0 vs false).
protects: Doc (config.ts:5-7): "The function will, by default, error when a field gets two values that aren't `===`-equal, but you can provide combine functions per field to do something else."
checkable: partly: the caller of combineConfig holds the configs and combine object and can test the same condition; an extension that only contributes a config to a facet whose combine calls combineConfig cannot see the other contributions before the configuration resolves (deduction).
public_entry: facet combine functions that call it (thrown while a configuration is resolved: EditorState.create, Transaction.state)

error: Error("Ranges must be added sorted by `from` position and `startSide`")
condition: strict (RangeSetBuilder.add and RangeSet.of pass true) && diff <= 0 && (from - this.lastFrom || value.startSide - this.last!.startSide) < 0, with diff = from - this.lastTo || value.startSide - this.last!.endSide (rangeset.ts:525-526). Evaluated in each builder layer the range reaches, so a range accepted by the top layer can throw in a nested layer (state.RangeSetBuilder.add.B3).
protects: Doc (rangeset.ts:513-514): "Ranges should be added in sorted (by `from` and `value.startSide`) order." The per-layer order is what cursors and binary searches rely on (hazard recorded on state.RangeSet^of.B2; deduction).
checkable: yes: sort first (RangeSet.of(ranges, true), or RangeSetUpdate.sort) or keep ranges in (from, startSide) order; RangeValue.startSide is public. The non-strict paths (RangeSet.update on a non-empty set, map) never throw it.
public_entry: RangeSet.update on the empty set with add and no sort (rangeset.ts:276)

error: RangeError(`Invalid position ${pos} in document of length ${this.length}`)
condition: pos < 0 || pos > this.length (text.ts:39). -0.5, length + 0.5 and Infinity throw; NaN passes and throws a TypeError later (implicit row text.ts:177/261); -0 passes.
protects: Positions must lie in the document (deduction from the message).
checkable: yes: 0 <= pos <= doc.length (Text.length); also !Number.isNaN(pos) for the implicit NaN throw.
public_entry: every caller passing a position to lineAt

error: RangeError(`Invalid line number ${n} in ${this.lines}-line document`)
condition: n < 1 || n > this.lines. 0.5, lines + 0.5 and Infinity throw; NaN passes (implicit row text.ts:177/261). Through iterLines(from, to): from outside 1..lines, or to > lines + 1 (reported as to - 1, text.ts:121-122).
protects: Line numbers are 1-based and must exist (deduction from the message).
checkable: yes: 1 <= n <= doc.lines (Text.lines).

error: RangeError("A document must have at least one line")
condition: text.length == 0
protects: Text.lines is documented "(always >= 1)" (text.ts:34); an empty array has no line (deduction).
checkable: yes: lines.length > 0. Internal callers always pass at least one line (String.split results with a non-empty separator, change.ts:335, state.ts:185, :246; part.slice(1) of length >= 1, change.ts:371), so only a direct Text.of call reaches it (deduction).

error: RangeError("Field is not present in this state")
condition: this.config.address[field.id] == null && require, require defaulting to true (passing undefined gives the default; passing false, null or 0 returns undefined instead: probe).
protects: Doc (state.ts:63-65): "Throws an error when the state doesn't have that field, unless you pass `false` as second parameter."
checkable: partly: state.field(f, false) returns undefined for an absent field, but also for a present field whose value is undefined; no other public API tells presence (deduction from the public surface).
public_entry: Facet.from getters (facet.ts:110, while a state is built)
Transaction.state / EditorState.create when a slot reads an absent field

error: RangeError("Invalid JSON representation for EditorState")
condition: !json || typeof json.doc != "string" (state.ts:223). The selection is checked afterwards by EditorSelection.fromJSON (no default).
protects: Rejects a JSON value with no string doc (deduction).
checkable: yes: shape test on the caller's value.

error: Error("Can't compute a static facet")
condition: this.isStatic (set from !!config.static in Facet.define, facet.ts:74).
protects: FacetConfig.static doc (facet.ts:21): "Forbids dynamic inputs to this facet." Static facet values are read from the configuration before a state exists (configuration.staticFacet, state.ts:246, :251); the link is a deduction.
checkable: no public test: isStatic is private (facet.ts:58); the caller can only know it from the facet's definition (allowMultipleSelections and lineSeparator are static, extension.ts:14, :19).

error: Error("Can't compute a static facet")
condition: this.isStatic
protects: Same as facet.ts:91.
checkable: no public test: isStatic is private (facet.ts:58).

error: RangeError(`Duplicate use of compartment in extensions`)
condition: a CompartmentInstance not seen before in this flatten (the seen map dedups the same instance object) whose compartment is already in newCompartments: two distinct instances (c.of(...) twice) of one compartment reached in one configuration, including one appended later or nested inside its own instance.
protects: One compartment maps to one slot of content in the configuration (newCompartments: Map<Compartment, Extension>) and Compartment.reconfigure replaces that content (deduction).
checkable: no public API lists the compartments inside an extension value; the caller can only avoid creating two instances of one compartment (deduction).

error: Error(`Unrecognized extension value in extension set (${ext}).`)
condition: ext is not an array, CompartmentInstance, PrecExtension, StateField or FacetProvider, and (ext as any).extension is falsy (plain objects, numbers, strings, functions, false, 0, "", {extension: null}). null or undefined throw the implicit TypeError at the same line (facet.ts:549). A top-level falsy extensions value in EditorState.create is replaced by [] (state.ts:244).
protects: Rejects values that are not extensions; the `extension` property is the escape hatch for wrapper objects (Extension type doc; deduction).
checkable: partly: a value can be tested for a truthy `extension` property or for being one of the package's exported classes; nested contents of compartments and wrappers resolve only at configuration time (deduction).

error: Error(`Unrecognized extension value in extension set (${ext}). This sometimes happens because multiple instances of @codemirror/state are loaded, breaking instanceof checks.`)
condition: as facet.ts:550 but ext.extension is truthy and == ext (an object whose extension property is itself).
protects: The message names the cause: extensions built by a second copy of @codemirror/state fail the instanceof checks; following `extension` would loop forever (deduction).
checkable: no meaningful advance check (the cause is two package copies); a caller can test ext.extension === ext (deduction).

error: Error("Cyclic dependency between fields and/or facets")
condition: state.status[idx] == SlotStatus.Computing when a dynamic slot is requested: a slot read while it is being computed. Also when a slot was left Computing by an exception in a previous computation of the same state (state.Facet.B10).
protects: Prevents infinite recursion between slot functions computed on demand (hazard on state.Facet.B9).
checkable: no: the dependency graph is formed by user functions at run time; a caller cannot query it.
public_entry: EditorState.field / EditorState.facet called from slot functions

error: TypeError("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')") (V8 message)
condition: pos NaN for lineAt or n NaN for line on a leaf document (at most 32 lines): NaN passes the range checks (text.ts:39, :46), the comparison against NaN is always false and the loop reads this.text[i] past the end (`string.length`).
protects: Not a guard: an unchecked domain error (no NaN test in lineAt/line).
checkable: yes: Number.isNaN(pos) / Number.isNaN(n) before the call.

error: TypeError("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')") (V8 message)
condition: the same NaN pos / n on a node document (more than 32 lines): the loop reads this.children[i] past the end (`child.length`). Seen by probe (100-line document, lineAt(NaN) and line(NaN)); the behavior rows cite only the leaf line.
protects: Not a guard (as text.ts:177).
checkable: yes: Number.isNaN before the call.

error: TypeError("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'text')") (V8 message)
condition: Text.replace with from NaN on a node document: clip (text.ts:580-583) propagates NaN, the first decompose pushes no part and a later decompose with Open.From pops undefined and reads prev.text. On a leaf the same call returns a document of length NaN; replace(0, NaN) on a node returns length NaN without throwing (probe).
protects: Not a guard: an unchecked domain error.
checkable: yes: Number.isNaN(from) before the call (clip handles every other out-of-range value).
public_entry: ChangeSet.apply and Transaction.newDoc with NaN change positions (deduction: apply calls doc.replace, change.ts:209)

error: TypeError("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')") (V8 message)
condition: Text.iter(dir) with dir 0 on a leaf document, at the first next(): the constructor sets the offset to the end (dir > 0 false) and nextInner steps by dir, so top.text[offset] is undefined (`next.length`).
protects: Not a guard: dir is typed 1 | -1 and not validated.
checkable: yes: pass 1 or -1.

error: TypeError("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')") (V8 message)
condition: Text.iter(0) on a node document, first next(): top.children[offset] is undefined (`next.length`). Seen by probe (100-line document); the behavior row and fixture use a leaf document.
protects: Not a guard (as text.ts:444).
checkable: yes: pass 1 or -1.

error: TypeError("this.inserted[(i >> 1)].toJSON is not a function") (V8 message)
condition: a change set whose inserted entry is not a Text: ChangeSet.of accepts any truthy non-string insert as a Text without a check (change.ts:335), e.g. insert: 7; toJSON then calls its toJSON.
protects: Not a guard: the ChangeSpec type (string | Text) is enforced only by TypeScript.
checkable: yes: pass insert as a string or a Text instance.
public_entry: EditorState.update / EditorState.changes with such a spec, then changes.toJSON (deduction)

error: TypeError("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'empty')") (V8 message)
condition: a ranges array with a hole or an undefined entry before the scan stops: replaceRange(range, which) with which > ranges.length writes past the end (selection.ts:163-165), and create reads range.empty on the hole.
protects: Not a guard: which is not validated.
checkable: yes: 0 <= which < selection.ranges.length (which == length appends a range; negative which is ignored, state.EditorSelection.replaceRange.B2, except on a selection of zero ranges, where the copy stays empty and selection.ts:189 throws).

error: TypeError("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')") (V8 message)
condition: the selection's ranges array holds `undefined` and the change is not empty: `r.map(change, assoc)` on the undefined entry. EditorState.create without allowMultipleSelections turns a zero-range JSON selection into [undefined] through asSingle (selection.ts:151-152), and asSingle with an out-of-range mainIndex gives the same [undefined] (state.EditorSelection.asSingle.B2; that it then throws here is a deduction from the code, not run); the next transaction with changes maps it (transaction.ts:212; stack selection.ts:129 <- transaction.ts:212).
protects: Not a guard: ranges are assumed to be SelectionRange objects.
checkable: yes: every entry of `selection.ranges` is defined (equivalently, for a fromJSON state, the JSON selection has at least one range and 0 <= main < ranges.length).
public_entry: EditorState.update / Transaction.newSelection (state built by EditorState.fromJSON with zero ranges and main -1)

error: TypeError("Cannot read properties of null (reading 'extension')") or "(of undefined ...)" (V8 message)
condition: null or undefined inside an extension array (or as compartment / Prec content): none of the instanceof tests match and (ext as any).extension reads a property of null/undefined. A top-level null/undefined `extensions` in EditorState.create is replaced by [] (state.ts:244).
protects: Not a guard (the explicit throw at :550 is the intended rejection).
checkable: yes: filter null/undefined out of extension arrays.

error: TypeError("value.spec.toJSON is not a function") (V8 message)
condition: a field passed in `fields` that is present in the state and whose spec has no toJSON (`value.spec.toJSON!` is a TypeScript non-null assertion only). Absent fields are skipped.
protects: Not a guard: the method doc requires serializable fields; the missing function is not checked.
checkable: partly: the caller can check that it defined toJSON in the field spec; StateField.spec is marked @internal (facet.ts:306-307), so only the field's own definition tells whether toJSON exists.

error: TypeError("field.spec.fromJSON is not a function") (V8 message)
condition: a field in `fields` whose property name is an own property of json and whose spec has no fromJSON; thrown when the field's init runs during EditorState.create (stack: state.ts:229 <- facet.ts:319 <- facet.ts:327). Not thrown when an earlier initField entry for the same field wins (a config `field.init` under a higher precedence): the JSON initializer is never run (state:F1411).
protects: Not a guard (non-null assertion only).
checkable: partly: StateField.spec is @internal (facet.ts:306-307); only the field's own definition tells whether fromJSON exists.

error: TypeError("Cannot read properties of null (reading 'endSide')") (V8 message)
condition: first range added to a builder with from == -1e9 (C.Far): from - this.lastTo is 0 (lastTo starts at -C.Far), so the || falls through to this.last!.endSide with last still null.
protects: Not a guard: -1e9 is the initial sentinel of lastFrom/lastTo (open question Q20).
checkable: yes: from > -1e9 (positions are non-negative in documents; negative positions are otherwise accepted, state.RangeValue.range.B2).

error: TypeError("Cannot read properties of null (reading 'length')") (V8 message)
condition: add after finish() (with at least one range added before finish), for a range that fits the top layer: finishInner set this.from = null (rangeset.ts:565) and addInner reads this.from.length. A range that overlaps the last one goes to a new nested builder without error.
protects: Code comment (rangeset.ts:565): "Make sure further `add` calls produce errors"; doc (rangeset.ts:555-556): "The builder can't be used anymore after this has been called."
checkable: yes: the caller knows whether it called finish; no public flag.

error: TypeError("Cannot read properties of null (reading 'length')") (V8 message)
condition: finish() called again on a builder whose first finish added ranges (this.from is null), including after an overlapping add that was silently accepted into a new nested builder. A builder finished while empty returns before nulling from and stays usable (probe: finish, add, finish does not throw).
protects: Same intent as rangeset.ts:529 (comment at :565).
checkable: yes: the caller knows whether it called finish.
